findings.summary: gitleaks binary not installed in gate-full job — runCheck ENOENT → hard FAIL on every PR
actionlint: IS_CI=true → runToolCheck FAILS (not SKIP). Must install actionlint OR add to parityContentHash PARITY_EXCLUDE so IS_CI divergence is acknowledged
fetch-depth: 0 missing from gate-full checkout — commitlint, tdd-evidence, id-stability, gitleaks history all silently skip or fail
ci-required must use needs.gate-full.result == 'failure' (not != 'success') to allow skip on docs_only PRs
EJS template 01-pr-fast.yml.ejs needs governance level guard (<% if (governanceLevel !== 'L1') { %>) around gate-full — L1 projects inherit L2 CI gate and break
Check-level parity branch 3 must run BEFORE local-result.json guard in check-local-ci-parity.mjs — otherwise dead code in CI
L3 in nightly is synonymous with L2 in check-all.mjs — no additional coverage. Use 'full' subcommand or document L3==L2 explicitly
gate-full needs timeout-minutes: 60 to prevent 6-hour hang on stuck check
parityContentHash covers only L1 gates — L2 parity rests on shared binary, not hash verification. Acceptable pre-existing design; document in PR
